adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, handleAdd() sets isInvalidEmail to true when ZAddGuestsInputSchema.safeParse fails, but on a subsequent valid attempt it directly calls addGuestsMutation.mutate(...) without clearing isInvalidEmail back to false. There is also no logic in the MultiEmail onChange path to clear isInvalidEmail when the user edits inputs. As a result, the generic error banner can remain visible during a pending mutation (spinner) even after inputs are corrected, which is unintended UI behavior introduced by this dialog.
